reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering seeds and tree products, prepared foods, a quest keepsake, tropical and orchard fruit, and poppy products were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established recipe names, crop timing, tree growth conditions, object gender, food descriptions, loanword preservation, and quoted tile terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

PineappleSeeds_Description.source: Plant these in warm weather. Takes 14 days to mature, and keeps producing fruit after that.
PineappleSeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le pe vreme caldă. Ajung la maturitate în 14 zile și continuă să producă fructe după aceea.

PineCone_Description.source: This can be planted to grow a pine tree.
PineCone_Description.translation: Poate fi plantat pentru a crește un pin.

PineTar_Description.source: A pungent substance derived from pine sap.
PineTar_Description.translation: O substanță cu miros înțepător, obținută din seva pinului.

PinkCake_Description.source: There's little heart candies on top.
PinkCake_Description.translation: Deasupra sunt bombonele în formă de inimă.

PiratesLocket_Description.translation: Este amintirea unui pirat de demult.

Pizza_Name.preservationReason: Pizza is the standard Romanian food name with the same spelling as the English source.

Pizza_Description.source: It's popular for all the right reasons.

Poi_Name.preservationReason: Poi is the established Hawaiian dish name and is used unchanged in Romanian.

Poi_Description.source: A traditional food with a delicate, sweet flavor when eaten fresh.
Poi_Description.translation: Un preparat tradițional cu o aromă delicată și dulce atunci când este mâncat proaspăt.

Pomegranate_Description.source: Within the fruit are clusters of juicy seeds.
Pomegranate_Description.translation: În interiorul fructului se află grupuri de semințe zemoase.

PomegranateSapling_Description.source: Takes 28 days to produce a mature Pomegranate tree. Bears fruit in the fall. Only grows if the 8 surrounding "tiles" are empty.
PomegranateSapling_Description.translation: Are nevoie de 28 de zile pentru a deveni un rodier matur. Rodește toamna. Crește doar dacă cele 8 „dale” din jur sunt libere.

Poppy_Description.source: In addition to its colorful flower, the Poppy has culinary and medicinal uses.
Poppy_Description.translation: Pe lângă floarea sa colorată, macul are întrebuințări culinare și medicinale.
